In that case, what is the fire more useful than? It is more useful than the Word. The cloud is the Spirit, and the fire is the Word. While the sun is shining, you are very clear in the Spirit; you can easily follow the cloud. However, many times it is like the night, and you are in the darkness. You cannot fully trust your spirit; your spirit is greatly deceived. In such a situation, you must rely on the Word. The Word is like a blazing fire, a bright light, and one that illuminates us. Psalm 119:105 says, “Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.” For one who is a close friend of the Lord and in whom everything shines brightly, the cloud is sufficient. But when darkness covers the sky and you cannot distinguish where the cloud is and where it is not, you must follow the Fire.

reference: HON'BLE UNION MINISTER SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA MEETS MAMIT DISTRICT OFFICIALS AND BENEFICIARIES. 83/2022-2023 Mamit 13th June, 2022: Shri PARSHOTTAM Rupala, Hon'ble Union Cabinet Minister, Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying today held a meeting with a District Officials and Beneficiaries of various centrally sponsor schemes at the conference hall of DC Mamit. The meeting was chaired by Pu Lalnunhlua DC Mamit. The Minister was appraised about the aspirational District programme undertakings and the present status in the delta ranking through power point presentation by Pu Lalsanglura, Nodal Officer of Aspirational District. Hon'ble Union Minister mentioned his purpose for his visited of the District and interaction with the Beneficiaries of various scheme. He assured full support for the proper implementation of the schemes so that the beneficiaries can enjoy the benefits as intended by the Government. In the meeting the Minister Interacted with the officials and beneficiaries of the following Central Scheme: AYUSHMAN BHARAT Health & Wellness, Ayushman Bharat Jan Arogya Yojana, e- Transaction, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar nidhi ( PM-Svanidhi), Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana ( Gramin/Urban), Jal Jeevan Mission ( Individual household connection & Schools), Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban/Gramin), PMMVY and PM-Kisan. Union minister is accompanied by the Director, Fisheries Department, Government of Mizoram and other Officials from Aizawl. Attachment Loading attachment...
hypothesis: UNION MINISTER SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA HOLDS MEETING IN MAMIT 882/2022-2023 Mamit 13th June, 2022: Shri Parshottam Rupala, Hon'ble Union Cabinet Minister for Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Govt. of India, held a meeting today at the DC Conference Hall, Mamit, with Government Officials and beneficiaries of various Central Schemes within Mamit district. In today's meeting, chaired by Mr. Lalnunhlua, District Deputy Commissioner, Mr. Lalsanglura, Aspirational District Programme Nodal Officer, gave a detailed Powerpoint presentation on various initiatives under the Aspirational District Programme. This was followed by discussions on progress made and future steps to be taken. Shri Parshottam Rupala, Union Minister, explained the purpose of his visit and meeting in Mamit District, stating that he is keen to ensure that the people of the district benefit from various Central Schemes and to monitor whether they are being implemented effectively, while remaining ready to help resolve any difficulties. He encouraged the concerned District Officers to study various Government programs thoroughly and take steps to ensure that beneficiaries truly benefit from them. As Mamit District is an Aspirational District, the Central Government has made provisions for bills up to 5 lakhs for the treatment of specific critical illnesses; he mentioned that out of 5 selected people from Mamit District, 3 have already been chosen to receive this, and efforts are ongoing so that the remaining 2 can also receive it. Regarding PM-Kisan, he stated that those with an Aadhaar Card, land, and a Bank Account can apply, and urged the concerned departments to ensure that as many farmers as possible in Mamit District benefit from this scheme. The Union Minister stated that he would attempt to follow up on the difficulties and needs raised by Government Officials and Beneficiaries during today's meeting. During this time, a question-and-answer session was held with beneficiaries and relevant officials of various Central Schemes, including AYUSHMAN BHARAT - Health & Wellness, Ayushman Bharat - Jan Arogya Yojana, e-Transaction, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar Nidhi (PM-Svanidhi), Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin/Urban), Jal Jeevan Mission (individual household connection & Schools), Sw

source: LAWNGTLAIAH DRAFT ELECTORAL ROLL 2020 TLANGZARH A NI Kum 2020 atana Lawngtlai District-a Assembly bial pathuma draft electoral roll chu Nimin (16.12.2019) khan Lawngtlai District Election Officer, Lawngtlai Bawrhsap ni bawk Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS chuan a office chamber-ah a tlangzarh a. Draft roll hi political party ai awhte hnenah a hlan nghal. hypothesis: His life was designed to be corrupted and destroyed. For example, suppose we tell our children at home not to play with the blackboard eraser. After I leave the house, they play with the eraser simply because they are curious; then, upon my return, I discover they have done something wrong. Their wrongdoing is merely a violation of household rules, and nothing [harmful] has entered into them. However, suppose instead that a very dangerous medicine was left in the house, and the children were told, “Never touch this.” After I leave the house, they discover that the bottle is interesting to handle—and in the end, they drink the dangerous poison. In this case, they have not only disobeyed the household rules, but something far worse has happened: a dangerous poison has entered into them. This is exactly what happened when Adam ate from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil in the Garden of Eden. Not only did he disobey God's prohibition, but the life of Satan entered into him. At that very moment, the interior of man was deeply wounded; in addition to the good, righteous, and prosperous human life he once possessed, he now also possessed the corrupted and evil life of Satan.

source: COMMERCE & INDUSTRIES MINISTER-IN LUNGLEIAH AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING HAWNG No.4122/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 26 th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana chuan vawiin khan Electric Veng, Lungleiah NABARD sum cheng nuai 1082.93 senga ruahman Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building a hawng. Hawnna inkhawm Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi kaihhruaiah Dr R Lalthangliana chuan Lunglei khawpui chhunga hmasawnna ruhrel liantham, khawtlang tana chhenfakawm tak leh eizawnna kawnga tangkai taka hman theih tur Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building zawhfel a ni chu lawmawm tiin a buaipuitu Commerce & Industries thawktute, building sa tu te leh Electric Veng Lunglei khawtlang te chungah lawmthu a sawi a. C&I Department hnuaiah hmalakna hrang hrang kalpui mek zel anih thu sawiin Lunglei Supermarket sakna tur cheng nuai 1400 NEC atanga sanction hmuh anih thu sawiin Bangladesh ram nena kan insumdawn tawnna atana ruahman Integrated Check Post (ICP), Kawrpuichhuah, Tlabung ti hlawhtling turin Department chuan theihtawp a chhuah mek zel thu a sawi a ni. A Department chan dangte hnuaia hmalaknte pawh sawilangin Minister chuan MZU Southern Campus atan DPR cheng vaibelchhe 400 sawrkar laipuiah thehluh tawh niin chak taka bawhzui mek a ni a, MZU Southern Campus tana hman lailawk tur Engineering College building chei that hna pawh thawh mek a ni, a ti a. Civil Hospital Lungleia Trauma Centre sak pawh zawh fel thuai beisei anih thu sawiin Multipurpose Laboratory Building, NEC sum cheng nuai 300 a ruahman mek pawh nakum kum tir lama zawhfel beisei anih thu a sawi. Lunglei Municipal Council (LMC) chungchang pawh sawiin Minister chuan Municipal body chak tak enkawlna hnuaiah Lunglei khawpui chuan kawng hrang hrangin hmasawnna a nei dawn a ni, a ti. He huna khualzahawm Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng chuan Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building hawn theiha peih fel a ni ta chu Pathian malsawmna ropui tak a ni tiin he hmasawnna ruhrel neih theihna tura sulsutute thawhrimna leh thahnemngaihna rah a ni, a ti a. He building ti hlawhtling tura bultan tu Pu Joseph Lalhimpuia chungah leh a hmun phal taka petu Electric Veng YMA te chungah lawmthu a sawi a ni. He building sak enkawltu AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl atangin Technical Report ngaihtlak a ni a. Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure hi NABARD, RIDF XXIII hnuaia project niin total project cost hi Rs. 1082.93 lakhs ani a. Hna hi 05/10/2018 ah thawh tan a ni. hypothesis: LUNGLEI DISTRICT - COVID-19 NO TOLERANCE FORTNIGHT No.6374/2020-2021. To prevent the rapid spread and continued transmission of the Covid-19 pandemic, and to ensure the public adheres to the restrictions imposed due to Covid-19, the Government of Mizoram has organized the Covid-19 ‘No Tolerance Fortnight’ from October 26 to November 9, 2020, which is being strictly implemented in Lunglei District. Simultaneously, the Jan Andolan Campaign, providing education on safety measures against Covid-19, is also ongoing. Yesterday, a meeting was held in the office chamber led by Lunglei DC & DLTF Chairman Pu V.Lalsangliana to discuss in detail the implementation of the Covid-19 No Tolerance Fortnight in Lunglei District. Approximately 30 workers from various government departments assigned to Covid-19 Executive Duty during the No Tolerance Fortnight have been divided into 24 teams, and their duty schedules have been finalized. Each team will have a Team Leader to further educate the public on Covid-19 prevention, and those who fail to comply with the guidelines will be fined without leniency. The Covid-19 Executive Duty personnel will strictly enforce the public compliance requirements of The Mizoram (Containment and Prevention of Spread of Covid-19) Act, 2020 and government orders; violators will be penalized, and fines will be collected through proper challans. Lunglei District has been divided into eight (8) sectors, with an Executive Magistrate/Incident Commander appointed to oversee each sector. Starting today, Covid-19 Executive Duty has commenced across Lunglei District in coordination with the VLTFs of each village. During the Covid-19 No Tolerance Fortnight, talk shows will be organized via local cable to reiterate various important information regarding the Covid-19 vaccine to the public. Banners regarding Covid-19 prevention have also been displayed at prominent locations within Lunglei town. VLTFs have also been requested to announce Covid-19 prevention and guidelines three (3) times daily in various villages/towns. Attachment Loading attachment...

hypothesis: In the whole world, there is still one chosen person of God, the human being who can say, “The ruler of this world is coming, but he has no hold over me” (John 14:30). In other words, in the Lord Jesus, there was not a single trace of this world's evil. We must carefully note that when the Lord Jesus came into this world, He did not come to be God, but He came to be a human being. God needed a human. If God Himself had dealt with Satan, it would have been very easy; Satan would have fallen instantly without a word. However, God did not intend to do it Himself. To defeat Satan, He wanted a human; He intended for a created being to defeat a created being. When the Lord Jesus became a human, He endured temptations just as humans do, and He experienced everything that humans experience. This human overcame, this human is the Victor. He ascended to heaven and sat at the right hand of God. Jesus is now crowned with “glory and honor” (Heb. 2:9), and He exists in honor.

reference: When we want to determine a believer’s condition in life, wecannotgobywhathemanifestsoutwardly;wemustsense the savor and the element in what he manifests. Is it the savor of God or the savor of man? Is it the element of God or the element of man? Many times our perception may not be accurate, but the smell is accurate. It is possible that a cer- tain piece of clothing appears very clean to you, but if you take it and smell it, youwill know that it is fu ll of a filthy odor.Thus,if we want to evaluate the condition of life within a man,it should be like sampling tea:just by a little tasting, youcan tell its flavor.
hypothesis: If we want to understand the state of the living believers, we cannot do so by looking only at the outward appearances; we must perceive the scent and the essence of their manifestations. Is it the scent of God or the scent of man? Is it the essence of God or the essence of man? Many times, our observations and understandings may not be entirely accurate, but the scent is usually precise. To you, a certain field may look very clean from a distance, but if you go closer and enter it, you will find it filled with a foul stench. In the same way, if you wish to judge the state of life within a person, it should be like tasting a sip of tea: from just a small sip, you can know its flavor.

In the same way, if you wish to judge the state of life within a person, it should be like tasting a sip of tea: from just a small sip, you can know its flavor.

reference: MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY LEADS GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES IN TAKING INTEGRITY PLEDGE 275/2023-2024 Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 is to be observed in the whole of India from today, i.e. 30th October till 5th November, 2023. This year the theme is - 'Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation'. Starting off the Vigilance Week in Mizoram too, Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma led the officials and staff of the Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO this morning in taking the 'Integrity Pledge' in the Secretariat Courtyard. Likewise, all Heads of Offices under the State Government also led the employees in their respective offices in taking the Integrity Pledge, in which each government servant avowed to follow probity and rule of law in all walks of life, to neither take nor offer bribe, to perform all tasks in an honest and transparent manner, to act in public interest, to lead by example exhibiting integrity in personal behavior and to report any incident of corruption to the appropriate agency. Along with other parts of the country, 'Vigilance Week 2023' was inaugurated in Mizoram this afternoon; under the leadership of Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma, all government employees, officials, and staff gathered at MINECO, Mizoram Secretariat to collectively take the 'Integrity Pledge'. Heads of Office in every government office also took the 'Integrity Pledge' together with the officers and staff working under them at their respective office locations. Through this Integrity Pledge, every government employee pledged to strongly oppose corruption, to strive to work correctly and honestly according to government rules and regulations, to maintain exemplary conduct and work ethics recognizing that their role is to serve the public, and to report any corruption they see or hear about to the government rather than ignoring it. Heads of Office in every government office also took the 'Integrity Pledge' together with the officers and staff working under them at their respective office locations. Through this Integrity Pledge, every government employee pledged to strongly oppose corruption, to strive to work correctly and honestly according to government rules and regulations, to maintain exemplary conduct and work ethics recognizing that their role is to serve the public, and to report any corruption they see or hear about to the government rather than ignoring it. Dr. Thangtea chuan Pathian ringtu mizo nih hi a nuama, pi leh pute atanga lungrual tak leh inpumkhatna nena thawkho thin kan nihna chuan rah tha chhuah zelin, Covid - 19 avanga nunna chan kan nei erawh pawi hle rualin hri dona kawnga kan hmalakna-a hlawhtlinna kan hmuh mekte leh India hmarchhak State pariat (8) zingah Covid - 19 vanga thi tlemna ber State kan ni chu Pathian avang leh kan thawhhona avang a ni a ti. Minister chuan hmasawnna kan hmuh mekte chu chho zawnga thlira in delhbeh tir mai lovin hmasawnna tluantling nei turin kan tih ve theih tawk theuha tan la thar turin kalkhawmte a fuih a. Kawngpui tha nei turin hmalakna kalpui mek niin khawchhak lam atanga khawthlang lam hawiin kawngsial hna thawh tan mek a nih thu a sawi bawk. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Bialtu MLA pawhin Mamit District-in hriselna kawnga hma kan sawn theihna tur leh Aspirational District kan nihna atanga khaichhuah kan nihna tura CSR hnuai atanga hmanraw tangkai tak tak lei a ni chu lawmawm a tih thusawiin Kan District Bawrhsap-in hemi kawnga hma a lakna chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi a. Covid-19 hripuiin khawvel a tih buai mek karah Mizoram chu Sorkar hmalakna chak tak a vang te, Kohhran mite tawngtaina vang te leh khawtlang hruaitute hmalakna avangin India ram state zingah a titha ber pawl kan ni chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Bialtu MLA chuan Mamit District-in kawngpui tha kan neih chu Mizoram Sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh berte zing a mi a nih avangin chak taka hmalakna kalpui a ni a, hun reilote-ah kawngpui tha kan nei thuai a beisei thu a sawi. Mamit District-in hriselna lama hma kan sawna, nu naupai te'n enkawlna tha zawk an dawn a, damdawi an mamawh angte an hmuh theihna tur bakah damlote enkawlna tha zawk leh rang zawk pek an nih theihna tura District chhung PHC/CHC leh Health Sub- Centre-te tana hmanraw lei hi Mamit District Bawrhsap hmalakna-in REC LTD, CSR Health Project hnuai atanga lei a ni. Vawiin-a sem tak Bolero Camper(4WD BS6) 11 lei nan hian Rs. 1,04,50,000/- hman niin Motor-te hi Health Care delivery a bik takin vaccination drive, Health camp conduct leh awareness pekna tur bakah, kawng that lohna hmun, motor naran in a thlen theih lohna khuate awlsam taka thlen theihnan 4 wheeled drive lei a ni a. Rs. 15,60,000/- senga lei damdawi chi hrang hrang 76 - Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol leh Diagnostic Kits 50 - Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit leh a dangte Sub Centre/Health & Wellness Centre- te hman tur khuallian hian a hlan bawk. He Project hian a tum ber chu Health & welness Centre hi mi tam zawkin health care services an dawn theihna tur leh a tlawhtute mamawh damdawi leh diagnostic kit te a thlawna pek chhuah a ni a, health and welness centre hi mi tam zawkin hmang tangkaia, an tlawh tam (footfall) nana kalpui a ni. Vawiin vek hian Rs. 24,60,000/- senga lei Laptop leh Speaker 52, Mamit District chhung khua tlawh pawh harsa leh health care facility nei thalo khuate tan awlsam zawka health care provider te an biak pawh zung zung theihna turin Telemedicine atan Health Department hnenah hlan a ni bawk. He hun hi Dr. Lalrozama, IAS, Deputy Commissioner chuan kaihruaiin, Pu Beitlotha Nohro, SDC pawhin report pe-in Health Project hnuaiah Aspirational District kan nih avanga hriselna lama hma kan sawn theihna tura thuam kan nih dante a tarlang a. reference: HEALTH MINISTER INAUGURATES 43RD ANNUAL CONFERENCE OF IMA, MIZORAM STATE BRANCH The Indian Medical Association (IMA), Mizoram State Branch observed its 43rd annual conference today at Aijal Club where the Minister for Health and Family Welfare Department Dr.R.Lalthangliana was the Chief Guest. The theme of this yearâ€™s conference is â€œEnding the HIV&AIDS Epidemic: Community by Communityâ€. Speaking at the inaugural function, the Minister said that the government is committed to advance public health efforts and improve health for all. He encouraged the medical community to revive their efforts and recommit themselves in serving the public. Established in 1976, the Mizoram State Branch of IMA currently has 750 members out of which 33 are newly inducted. The Mizoram State Branch received two prestigious awards this year, namely the IMA Special Award for Organizing (IMA North East Leaders Meet Conclave) and President Appreciation Award (for IMA Membership Drive Trophy) from the IMA General Headquarters. The IMA is a voluntary organization where all doctors, whether employed by the government or practising in private, are registered members. The organization looks after the interest of doctors as well as the well being of the community at large. It aims to promote medical and its allied sciences, improve public health and maintain honour and dignity of the medical profession.
hypothesis:
HEALTH MINISTER ATTENDS IMA MIZORAM BRANCH CONFERENCE
Today, the Indian Medical Association (IMA) Mizoram State Branch held its 43rd Annual Conference at the Aijal Club. Dr. R. Lalthangliana, the Health Minister, was the chief guest. The theme for this year's IMA Annual Conference was “Ending the HIV&AIDS Epidemic: Community by Community.” Dr. R. Lalthangliana stated that the government prioritizes the health sector and that health is given significant importance even in the SEDP, one of the Mizoram government's primary initiatives. Stating that the government is open to health advancements and is taking strong steps toward progress, the Minister mentioned that the government is prepared to do its utmost in various areas, including the construction of a Cancer Super Speciality Hospital in Zemabawk, the improvement of ZMC, the advancement of RIPANS, and the development of various hospitals and healthcare services within Mizoram. Dr. R. Lalthangliana encouraged the doctors and nurses, describing them as servants of the people who perform an important and honorable job. He urged them to continue offering their skills and abilities to the public, reminding them that beyond medical science, their kind words alone can be healing for the sick, and encouraging them to rededicate themselves to this service. The conference opening program was led by IMA President Dr. Rosangliana, and Honorary Secretary Dr. Chawnglungmuana presented a report on the association's various activities. The IMA Mizoram State Branch has 33 members and 15 new intern members. Among the current members, there are 15 newly graduated Specialists (MD/MS). This year, they received the IMA Special Award for Organizing (IMA North East Leaders Meet Conclave) and the President Appreciation Award (for IMA Membership Drive Trophy) from the IMA Headquarters. The association organizes special clinics in rural areas, where they provide free medical check-ups for patients with various equipment and tools. To advance medical knowledge, they organize various seminars for their members, and at this current conference, they studied HIV and AIDS in detail.

reference: Did Paul disclose all his revelations? Far from it. He wrote, “I know a man [who is himself] in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body I do not know, or outside the body I do not know; God knows) such a one was caught away to the third heaven” (v. 2). He did not divulge this experience until fourteen years later. What depth there was in Paul! It would be a wonder if we could hide away something we received from God for seven years. But for fourteen years Paul never divulged his experience; for fourteen years God’s church knew nothing of it; for fourteen years not one of the apostles had heard of it. Paul’s roots were deep beneath the soil.
hypothesis: Did Paul reveal everything he knew? Not at all. He wrote, “I know one man in Christ (that is, himself), who fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I say not; whether out of the body, I know not; God knows) was caught up to paradise.” (ch. 2) He did not disclose this experience until fourteen years had passed. How profound Paul was! It would be a marvel if we could keep things received from God secret for ten years. Yet, for fourteen years, Paul never spoke of his experience; for fourteen years, the congregations of God did not know; for fourteen years, not even one of the apostles knew. The grave of Paul beneath the earth is truly deep.

reference: MYC CHAIRMAN LAYS FOUNDATION STONE FOR MYC INCUBATION CENTRE AT SERKAWN, LUNGLEI No.573/2021-2022 Aizawl the 28th March, 2022 : MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia, Lunglei North MLA laid the foundation stone for Mizoram Youth Commission Incubation Centre at Serkawn,Lunglei near Lena Stadium on Saturday (26th March, 2022). The land for the Incubation Centre was donated by Serkawn VC. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Pu H. Lalnunzuala, Under Secretary MYC, Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and representatives from Serkawn locality and various NGOs were also present at the occasion. On the occasion of this foundation stone laying ceremony, MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia said this centre would cater to the needs of aspiring Mizo youths such as competitive coaching, Information Technology, skill development and entrepreneurship. He thanked the local leaders of Serkawn who donated the property to MYC, and promised them that the centre would be used for the betterment of society and the economy. Talking about the MYC Coaching Centres in Lunglei, Siaha, Kolasib Districts and the one in Champhai which will be opened shortly, the MYC Chairman said that he along with the MYC team would continue working in earnest for the advancement of Mizo youths to the best of their capabilities. He stated that construction of MYC Youth Centres are underway at Aizawl,Serchhip and Lunglei. In addition to competitive exams, MYC is planning to continue to provide cement mistiri training, food processing training, cake baking training, cabin crew, Army Pre-Recruitment training and promotion of music and sports to help the youths reach their goals at the national level. The MYC Chairman said that the MYC Super IAS 20 which was started in 2020 will be upgraded to Super IAS 40 which will comprise of 20 more aspirants. He further said that the road connecting Khawiva, Aizawl-Thenzawl-Lunglei road and roads in Lunglei town will be repaired and that the budget for the improvement works for MZU Southern Campus is raised to Rs.15 crore. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng shared that although the staff of MYC are few in number, their contributions to the future of Mizo youths are commendable. He stated his appreciation for the Incubation Centre and urged the people to make the most out of this centre. Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and Pu K. Zodinsanga, VCP Serkawn also gave a brief speech, Pu Lalmuanzuala, CC, MYC Lunglei ended the ceremony with vote of thanks speech. Attachment Loading attachment...

reference: SPORTS MINISTER LAUDS MIZORAM GIRLSâ€™ VICTORY IN NES U-19 FOOTBALL CHAMPIONSHIP Headquarters 23 Sector Assam Rifles today organised a felicitation programme at Loch Hall within the precincts of 46 Assam Rifles, Aizawl for team members of the Mizoram U-19 Girls Team who recently lifted the Assam Rifles organized North East States Under-19 Championship held during July 17-21 at Diphu and Kohima. Sports Minister Shri Robert Romawia Royte presided over the function and lauded the efforts of the team members and the support provided by the Assam Rifles. Speaking on the occasion, the Minister highlighted the role football has played in connecting the North Eastern states with the rest of the country and said that it is an important tool in strengthening national integration and in helping the region mainstream with the rest of the country. Appreciating the cooperation between the Mizoram Government and Mizoram Football Association (MFA) in furthering the cause of football, the Minister expressed hope that this partnership will grow stronger and reach new heights in the coming days. He said that the Government will support MFA and other sports organizations and associations in all the possible way whether through financial assistance or otherwise. He pointed that for the first time ever Mizoram will soon have a comprehensive sports policy â€˜Mizoram Sports Policyâ€™ and through this policy Mizoram will achieve accolades in sports, he added. The Minister also spelt out new initiatives in the pipeline for development of football in the state and said that Flood Lighting and other works of Rajiv Gandhi Stadium to meet international standards will soon be completed. MFA President Shri Lal Thanzara and other office bearers of MFA were also present on the occasion. Attachment Loading attachment...
hypothesis: SPORTS MINISTER FELICITATES NES U-19 TEAM: A felicitation programme was organized today at Loch Hall, 46 Assam Rifles, by the Headquarters 23 Sector Assam Rifles for the Mizoram Team, which emerged as champions in the recently held NES Under-19 Women Football Championship. The event was graced by Sports Minister Pu Robert Romawia Royte, and leaders of the Mizoram Football Association (MFA) were also present. In his speech, Sports Minister Pu Robert Romawia Royte congratulated the Mizoram Women's U-19 Team on becoming champions of the NES U-19 Championship, stating that this victory does not belong to the Government, the organizers and supporters from the Assam Rifles, or the MFA, but to all the people of Mizoram, calling the team the pride of the state. He highlighted that the Mizoram Women's team's victory over the Nagaland Women's team—who represent India at the international level—demonstrates the skill of our women footballers. He stated that the Government would continue to support, encourage, and strengthen the MFA's efforts in football development as much as possible, and invited MFA leaders to continue and strengthen the excellent cooperation between the Government and the MFA. Pu Robert Romawia Royte described football as a powerful tool for national unity and strength, noting that through football, the relationship between North Eastern states and other parts of India has improved, fostering a better spirit of brotherhood and strengthening national unity; he added that the potential of football is immense and immeasurable. He mentioned that because the Government wishes to advance other sports disciplines even more vigorously alongside football, they are currently working on the Mizoram Sports Policy, which the state has never had before. He expressed happiness over the growth of taekwondo, basketball, and volleyball, stating that the Government is considering ways to strengthen sports associations and that he, as Sports Minister, will do his utmost to ensure better management. He further mentioned that efforts are underway to install high-quality floodlighting at the Rajiv Gandhi Sports Stadium to enable international-level matches, that sites are being scouted for 4 or 5 additional football fields in Aizawl city, that sanction has already been granted for grassing the Zembawk field, and that plans are being made for grassing the Khawzawl field. The Sports Minister appreciated the contribution of the Assam Rifles toward football and the progress of Mizo youth, inviting them to continue this fruitful cooperation and to do their best

source: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati in Sainik School Chhingchhip a tlawh 2122/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, the 30th September 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan vawiin khan Sainik School Chhingchhip a tlawh a. He hunah hian School building leh hmunhma te a endik a, Sikul naupangte hmaah fuihna thu a sawi bawk a ni. Governor hian Sainik School a thlenin amah zahna chibai 8 Bn Assam Rifles ten School kawtah an lo buk a. Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal leh Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer ten zirtirtute leh School staff te an hmelhriattir chhunzawm a. Hemi zawh hian Principal Office ah Sainik School dinhmunte inhrilhhriatna hun neih leh a ni a. Assembly Hall-ah Official programme leh Cultural Programme neih chhunzawm nghal a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Principal leh a thawhpui ten Sainik School tha tak ni tur leh hmun danga Sainik School te dinhmun pha tura theihtawp an chhuah chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi hmasa a. Mizoram sawrkarin hetiang ang School tha bik Mizorama zirlaite tan a buatsaih thei chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk a ni. Sainik School Chhingchhip hi India ram hmundang te aia a danglam bik na chu helai hmunah hian Sainik School dangte entawn turin a vawikhatna atana leh a hmahruaitu ni turin hmeichhe naupangte luh tir an ni a. Hei hi a chhuanawm tak zet a ni a ti. Sainik School te hi khawi hmunah pawh School thabik an ni a, Sipai, Navy leh Airforce Officer ni turin a bik takin heng schoolah te hian zirlai te zirtirna pek a ni a ti. Sainik School a zirlaite hi Armed Forces ah an thawkvek kher lo a nih pawhin khawtlang leh ram tana khua leh tui entawn tlak ni tura chher an nih thu a sawi bawk. India chakna chu danglamna tam tak kara inpumkhatna leh inunauna tha a ni tih zirlaite chu a hrilh nawn leh a. He mawhphurhna huangah hian Sainik School zirlaite chu hmahruaitu ni turin a chah a ni. Full speech of the Honble Governor : dipr.mizoram.gov.in/post/speech-of-dr-hari-babu-kambhampati-honble-governor-of-mizoram-on-the-occasion-of-visit-to-sainik-school-chhingchhip-on-30th-september-2022 Maj S.Kalyan, Adm in Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati lawmna thu a sawi hmasa a. Hemi hnu hian Assembly Hall chhunga programme hi tan a ni a. Zirlai ten Governor pualin Cultural programme an hmang a. WCdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, Sainik School, Chhingchhip chuan lawmthu sawiin huntawp a khar a ni. Official programme zawh hian Saini School Campus chhunga School building leh hmunhma te Governor chuan a endik chhunzawm nghal a ni. Principal Report atanga a lan dan chuan Sainik School Chhingchhip hi kum 6 hmel a hmu mek a. Tunah hian batch hmasa ber(Class VI) te chu Class XI an ni mek a ni. Sainik School a lut tur hian All India Entrance Test paltlang a ngai a. Sikul naupang pakhat tana kum khat chhunga senso chu Rs 1.85 lakh velah chhut a ni. Kumtin Class VI ah hian mipa naupang 60 leh Hmeichhe naupang 10 admission pek an ni mek a. Class IX ah erawh chuan mipa chiah admission pek niin kum tin seat 10 a awm thin a ni. School naupangte hian zing dar 5 vel atangin zan dar 9:30 vel thleng nitin, lehkha zirna hun, infiamna leh thildang tangkai zir nan hun an hmang thin a. Lehkha zirna leh a kaihhnaih(cocurricular activities) bakah zirlaite tan hian taksa insawizawina leh themthiamna chidangte ( extracurricular activities) atana hmunhma pawimawh Football Ground, Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Gynasium, Music room,etc., te he school hian a nei a. Swimming pool, parade ground leh sports facility tangkai tak tak buatsaih chhoh zel a tum bawk. Principal hian Mizoram sawrkar in tanpuina a pek thin - GIA dinhmun te, Ambulance te chi MRB in CSR kaltlanga pek a tum chungchang te, NCC te tana tangkai INSAS silai Home Department, Govt of Mizoram in pek a tum chunchang te Rs 99,96,000 school tihphuisuina atana Ministry of Defence atang sum lo kal tur chungchangte a sawi a. An harsatna pahnih Tui Bill sang tak leh Electric chhit man sang lutuk chungchangte pawh sawi a ni. Kawlphetha a harsatna sutkian a nih theih nan campus chhunga Solar Power Generation Plant bun turin Governor chuan Sainik School Chhingchhip hotute chu thurawn a pe a. Tui bill chungchang pawh Serchhip DC office leh PHED ten chinfel sak turin hma an la mek tih sawi a ni. Governor in Sainik School, Chhingchhip a tlawhnaah hian Pu Lalmuansanga Ralte, Addl DC leh Pu Stephen Lalrinawma, SP, Serchhip District pawh an tel a ni. Attachment Loading attachment...
reference: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Sainik School Chhingchhip 191/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, the 30th September 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati who is on an official tour of Serchhip District visited Sainik School, Chhingchhip, a few miles away from Serchhip town today. Upon his arrival, Governor was accorded the Guard of Honour by 8 Bn of Assam Rifles. He was then introduced to the staff by Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, and Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer. A briefing about the School to Governor was given by the Principal in his office room. After this, an official function with a cultural program was organized inside the Assembly Hall in honour of the esteemed visitor. Here, the Governor addressed the students. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati congratulated faculties for their best effort to keep up with other establishwd Sainik Schools in the country. He thanked the state government for bring up a highly valuable asset of national importance in education like Sainik school here in Mizoram. He expressed his pride of having the first Sainik School in the country where girl students are admitted. He stressed the importance of Sainik Schools for preparing the young students to become cadet officers in Army, Airforces and Navy. Beside this, he said the school also prepared the students to become role model students and role model citizen. He reminded the students of the school about their important duties for the national integration of the county. Full speech of the Honble Governor : https://dipr.mizoram.gov.in/post/speech-of-dr-hari-babu-kambhampati-honble-governor-of-mizoram-on-the-occasion-of-visit-to-sainik-school-chhingchhip-on-30th-september-2022 The programme began with welcome address by Maj S.Kalyan, Admn and concluded with vote of thanks proposed by WCdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, Sainik School, Chhingchhip. After the official programme, Governor inspected the facilities inside the campus of Sainik School Chhingchhip. As per the briefing by the Principal, here are the few highlights of the school. The school is now 6 years old and running with the pilot cadets in Class XI. The annual intake of students are 60 boys and 10 girls in the class VI while in the class IX only boys are admitted with the availability of 10 seats for students annually. The annual fee per a student is estimated at Rs 1.85 lakh per year. The schools have daily routine for winter and summer and winter with the physical and classroom activities through out the day. It usually starts from very early morning till 9:00 to 9:30 PM at night. Apart from the facilities for cocurricular activities, the School is also currently having the facilities like Football Ground, Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Gynasium, Music room,etc.,. The swimming pool, parade ground and other big sports facilities are being planned to be added very soon. The Principal highlighted the status of Grant in Aid from the state, issues with water and power bills, LMV ambulance to be received from the Mizoram Rural Bank through CSR, INSAS rifles to be received from Home Department, Government of Mizoram, Infrastructural Fund received to the tune of Rs 99,96,000 the Ministry of Defence with the proposed implementations. To solve the issue with high power bills, the Governor advised implementation of Solar Power Generation plant inside the campus. While, the issue with high water bills is being taken up the office Deputy Commissioner and is expected to be solved very soon. Governor in his visit to Sainik School, Chhingchhip was escorted and given a company by Pu Lalmuansanga Ralte, Addl DC and Pu Stephen Lalrinawma, SP, Serchhip District. He further added that even if the students of Sainik School do not all join the Armed Forces, they are trained to be exemplary citizens for the community and the country. He reminded the students that India's strength lies in its unity and brotherhood amidst great diversity, and he urged the students of the Sainik School to be leaders in this responsibility. raw_text: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Sainik School Chhingchhip 2122/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, September 30, 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visited Sainik School Chhingchhip today. During this visit, he inspected the school buildings and premises and delivered an encouraging speech to the students. Upon the Governor's arrival at the Sainik School, he was received with a guard of honor by the 8th Bn Assam Rifles at the school gate. Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, and Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer, introduced him to the teachers and school staff. This was followed by a briefing on the status of the Sainik School in the Principal's Office. Subsequently, an official program and a cultural program were held in the Assembly Hall. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati first praised the Principal and his colleagues for their efforts to make Sainik School an excellent institution and to make it a benchmark for other Sainik Schools. He also expressed his happiness that the Government of Mizoram could provide such a specialized school for the students of Mizoram. He noted that what makes Sainik School Chhingchhip unique compared to others in India is that it is the first to admit girl students to serve as role models for other Sainik Schools. He stated that this is very commendable. He mentioned that Sainik Schools are excellent institutions wherever they are located, specifically providing training for students to become officers in the Army, Navy, and Air Force. He further added that even if the students of Sainik School do not all join the Armed Forces, they are trained to be exemplary citizens for the community and the country. He reminded the students that India's strength lies in its unity and brotherhood amidst great diversity, and he urged the students of the Sainik School to be leaders in this responsibility. source: Presbyterian Communications Board/Department hna pui ber chu thu ziak rawngbâwlnain hma a sâwn zêl theih nân, Synod leh a hnuaia pêng hrang hrangten thil chhut tûr an neih apiang fel taka chhut te, chûng zînga zawrh chi chu mipuiin an lei theih tûra a tlâwm thei anga zawrh a ni. Synod hnuaia Department hrang hrangten lehkhabu leh thil dang chhut ngai an neihte chu Synod Press-a chhut zêl tûra tih a ni a (SEC 233:39). Chutiang bawkin Synod Office leh a hnuaia Department hrang hrangten office mamawh (stationeries) an neihte chu a theih hrâm chuan Synod Bookroom-a mi lei tûra tih a ni a, Synod Bookroom-in an pêk theih loh thu an ziak thilte chauh hmun danga lei tûra tih a ni {Synod Sum Vawn Dân Bung 10:10 (1)}.
reference: The main objectives of the Presbyterian Communication Board/Department is to spread the Gospel through publication and printing words and it is responsible for the publication of any works required by Synod and all the departments under it. It also provides cheaper and accessible books for the masses as well. Synod and its departments are to publish their books and any other publication under Synod Press. (SEC 233:39). Similarly, all the departments are to buy their stationary needs from the Synod Bookroom as well. {Synod Sum VawnDân Bung 10:10 (1)}.
hypothesis: The primary function of the Presbyterian Communications Board/Department is to ensure the continued progress of written publications; therefore, the Synod and its various subordinate departments shall have all their publications printed accurately, and those intended for sale shall be sold at the lowest possible price for the public. Various departments under the Synod that require the printing of books or other materials are directed to continue using the Synod Press (SEC 233:39). Similarly, the Synod Office and its various subordinate departments are directed to purchase office stationery from the Synod Bookroom whenever possible; materials that the Synod Bookroom cannot provide may then be purchased from other sources {Synod Financial Regulations Chapter 10:10 (1)}.

Sawrkar laipui ruahmannain Rozgar Mela/Job Fair chu August ni 28, Thawhtanni hian State hrang hrang 25 a hmun 44 ahte huaihawt a ni dawn a. He hunah hian Indian Government hnuai Department hrang hranga hna hmu thar mi 70,000 dawnte hnenah appointment letter pek chhuah a ni ang. Prime Minister Pu Narendra Modi chuan ram pum huap hun hman hi a kaihruai dawn a, live streaming kaltlangin thalaite hnena thuchah a sawi hnuah hna hmu thar a hmuna awmte hnenah appointment letter a sem chhuak dawn a ni. Mizorama Rozgar Mela/Job Fair hlawhtling taka huaihawt a nih theih nan Assam Rifles chuan hma a la a, he hun hi Sawrkar laipuia Minister of State for Minority Affairs Pu John Barla chuan a hmanpui dawn a, hna hmu tharte kutah appointment letter a hlan dawn a ni. Ram chhung hmun hrang hranga hun hmante hi Prime Minister chuan Video Conferencing kaltlangin a chhim dawn a ni. God puts His Spirit in us so that His Spirit may be the indwellingSpiritwithinus,thatwemayknowGodandexpe- rience all that God in Christ has accomplished for us (Rom. 8:9-11). A. As an Indwelling Spirit
God has placed His Spirit within us, and thus His Spirit becomes an indwelling Spirit within us, through which we can have the knowledge of God and all the experiences that Christ has achieved on our behalf (Rom 8:9-11). This is a special blessing that God gave in the New Testament; it was not always present in the Old Testament. In the Old Testament, God made His Spirit only to work upon humans externally, and He did not make His Spirit to dwell within humans. reference: Let me also state that people must not rush to push the government to provide for their needs. So, time management is the most important key. I think the way files are processed hierarchy-wise also needs to be revised to save more time.
hypothesis: Furthermore, Mr. Speaker, we will not go through all the major plans and programs the government has developed and formulated. Today, I am simply reflecting on one concern—that because of our impatience, the public might perceive the government as being inefficient. Regarding point number one, time management will be very important. In terms of government operations, what I find most crucial is our current file movement process: a file comes from the directorate, is first handled by the Superintendent in the Secretariat, then by the Under Secretary, then moves up to the Deputy Secretary, then to the Joint Secretary, then to the Additional Secretary, then to the Secretary, and finally to the Minister. I feel we urgently need to improve this process. For a new government to function effectively, time is of the essence, and that is what has been on my mind.

A reception was held today at the Lunglei BDO Conference Hall for the medal winners from the Lunglei East Assembly Constituency in the Mizoram State Games 2019, which concluded last December. The event was hosted by Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, MLA of Lunglei East AC and Vice Chairman of Lunglei HPC. In the Mizoram State Games 2019, Lunglei East AC won 23 medals (7 Gold, 7 Silver, 9 Bronze) across various sports disciplines, ranking 11th in the state and 1st in the Lunglei District. Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng expressed his happiness that Lunglei East AC achieved a strong position in the Mizoram State Games 2019 and thanked the Organizing Committee members, athletes, and party leaders, stating that this was the fruit of their hard work and dedication. He encouraged the athletes to give their best to achieve success at the National and International levels beyond the State level, urging their youth leaders to guide them properly and emphasizing that education is essential regardless of the path they choose. He also urged them to look into and study the incentives provided by the government for athletes. Today's awardees were the medal winners from various sports disciplines, who received citations and cash prizes. Out of the 32 sports disciplines in the Mizoram State Games, Lunglei East AC participated in 19 and won 23 medals (7 Gold, 7 Silver, 9 Bronze), ranking 11th in the state and 1st in the Lunglei District.

Hemi hnu hian Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) leh Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Housing for All (Urban) hnuaia hamthatna dawngtute tlawhin a kawm a ni. Governor hi Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga, Champhai South bialtu MLA ni bawk bakah DC Champhai Pu James Lalrinchhana, SP Pu Lalrinpuia Varte leh Official dangten an tawiawm a ni. Governor Pu Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Champhai Winery tlawh theia a awm chu lawmawm a tih thu sawiin, an hmalaknate engemawchen a lo hriat tawh thu a sawi a. Champhai District-a Winery pahnih lai a awm leh loneitute intelkhawmin an kalpui chu ropui a tih thu a sawi a. Grape chingtuten harsatna an tawh chu pawi a tih thu sawiin, Sawrkarin dan thar siama hma a la chu lawmawm a ti a. Wine siam chu food processing hnuaia a awm anih thu sawiin, agriculture product-te cheibawla siam danglam value addition chu hmalakna pawimawh tak a ni, a ti a. Tun aia nasaa huang zauh leh changtlung zawka kal tura Ministry of Food Processing Industries kaltlanga hmalakna an nei chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Governor chuan Grape chauh nilo thei dang sawr leh um theihte pawh ngaihvena huang zauh a tul thu a sawi a. An hmalak lehzelna turah duhsakna a hlan a, Mizoram mai nilo India rama loneitute tana entawntlak leh tihhmuhtu nih tum turin a chah a ni. Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga chuan Champhai District chhunga loneitute hmalakna pawimawh tak grape sawngbawlna hmunhma Governor-in a hun hlu tak senga a tlawh chu lawmawm a ti a. Hun harsa tak paltlanga dan anga grape zawrhna tur dan thar Sawrkarin a siam thu sawiin, grape chingtuten hmabak eng tak an neih thu sawiin duhsakna a hlan a. Tun aia nasa zawka hma la a, ram ngaw humhalh nan kum tina lovah thin bansana lo nghet nei thei tura ngaihtuahna seng turin a chah a. Tun atanga reiloteah Sapthei sawngbawlna turte pawh buaipui tum anih thu sawiin, harsatna an neihte a hnena thlen hrehlo turin a chah a ni. Inkawmhona hun Packing Hall, Champhai Winery, Tlangsama hman hi Pu HS.Vanlalfakzuala, Chairman, Champhai Grape Growers Society (CGGS) chuan a kaihruai a. Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager hnen atangin report ngaihthlak a ni a. Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Limited hotute atangin thusawi ngaihthlak a ni bawk. Mizoram hi North East India-a grape thar awm chhun leh India rama grape thar tam 5-na niin, Champhai leh Hnahlan-ah Winery a awm a. CGGS enkawl Champhai Winery hian kum 14 hmel a hmu tawh a, an Grape sawngbawl hi Bangalore Blue variety niin, vawiin thlengin Grape quintal ,15,218 an lei tling tawh a, hemi atan hian Rs 5,78,41,160/- (cheng vaibelchhe nga maktaduai sarih nuai riat singli sangkhat za leh sawmruk) an seng tawh a ni. Kum 2010 atang khan Grape quintal 918 leiin bul an tan a, kum kalta khan quintal 1144.98 an lei tling a, an Grape lakte hi herin a umna zemah an um mek a ni. Kum 2007 khan Champhai Grape Growers Association (CGGA) tih thin chu Winery din anih dawn avangin Champhai Grape Growers Society (CGGS) ti a thlak niin, Firms & Society-ah an inziahlut a ni. MIP sum cheng nuai 83 (loan) hmanga bultan niin, he loan hi November ni 9, 2020 khan Sawrkar chuan rulh let ngai lo turin grant-ah a leh sak a ni. Champhai Grape Growers Society-ah hian Governing Board Member 15 awmin kum 2 danah inthlan thin a ni a. Tun dinhmunah hian Champhai Grape Growers Society-ah hian Grape chingtu member 134 awm mekin, Staff leh Worker mi 30, Executive Member 9 leh Office Bearer 6 an awm mek bawk a. Champhai Grape Growers Society hnuaiah hian Branch 9 awm mekin mumal taka inenkawlna kalpui thin a ni. CGGS hian Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MOFPI) kaltlangin project an kalpui mek a. DC Office kaltlangin Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) hnuaiah Commerce & Industries Department hnuaiah project dil mek a ni bawk a. Dan thar hnuaiah Winery License an nei fel tawh a, State pawn thlenga hralhchhuak thei turin hmachhawp an nei a ni. Champhai Winery a tlawh zawh hian Governor chuan BPL family-te tana a thlawna eirawngbawlna gas connection pekna scheme, Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) kaltlanga hamthatna dawngtu leh khawpuia cheng insak tanpuina scheme, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Housing for All (Urban) dawngtu Tlangsam ami te a tlawh a; scheme awmzia leh tangkainate a sawifiah a, an hmuh dan leh chhawr tangkai dante a zawt nghal bawk. reference: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Champhai Tlangsam Winery 326/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 1st February 2023 : Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati, who is on a two-day tour of Champhai District visited the Tlangsam Winery on the outskirt of Champhai Town this evening. At the site, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati was given an escorted tour to various units by the managing officers of the winery. Thereafter, a short program was held at B Remmawia Packing hall, Champhai Winery. Governor Hari Babu expressed his delight in visiting the factory started, owned, and managed by a society of farmers. He was particularly appreciative of having witness the production centre where the determined farmers themselves added value to their products. He congratulated the Champhai Grape Growers Society and the Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Ltd. Governor welcomed the ambitious proposal to upgrade these wineries at Champhai and Hnahlan to accomodate the growing production of the Grapes in these areas. He extended his support for this proposal and if necessary, he agreed to discuss the matter with the authorities in the Ministry of Food Processing Industries(MoFPI). On behalf of Champhai Winery, Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager, Champhai Grape Growers Society(GGGS) gave a report. The Winery was started in 2007. After 14 years of existence with the production actually started in 2010 the Winery has now grown. At present the society has 134 members. The fruit is of Bangalore Blue variety. During last year the Winery bought 1144.98 qts of grapes. As the grape production increases, CGGS submitted two projects - one project to MoFPI and another project to state department under Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK). raw_text:
GOVERNOR HARI BABU KAMBHAMPATI VISITS CHAMPHAI WINERY AND MEETS BENEFICIARIES OF PMUY AND PMAY-HFA URBAN 3449/2022-2023 Champhai, 1st February, 2023: Mizoram Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati, who is on a two-day visit to Champhai, visited the Champhai Winery in Tlangsam this afternoon to review its progress and met with officials from the Champhai Grape Growers Society and the Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Limited. Following this, he visited and met with beneficiaries of the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) and the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Housing for All (Urban). The Governor was accompanied by Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga (who is also the MLA for Champhai South), DC Champhai Pu James Lalrinchhana, SP Pu Lalrinpuia Varte, and other officials.

Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati expressed his pleasure in visiting the Champhai Winery, noting that he had already heard about their progress. He praised the existence of two wineries in the Champhai District and the collaborative effort of the farmers. Expressing sympathy for the difficulties faced by grape growers, he welcomed the Government's implementation of new regulations. Stating that wine production falls under food processing, he remarked that value addition—transforming agricultural products—is a very important step. He also expressed appreciation for the collaboration with the Ministry of Food Processing Industries to expand and modernize operations. The Governor suggested that besides grapes, other fruits and berries should also be considered for expansion. He extended his best wishes for their future progress and urged them to become a model and inspiration for farmers not only in Mizoram but across India.

Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga expressed gratitude to the Governor for taking the time to visit the grape processing site, a significant achievement for farmers in the Champhai District. He mentioned that the Government has formulated new regulations for grape cultivation to overcome difficult times, giving grape growers a clear future, and extended his best wishes. He urged for further progress and the adoption of sustainable practices to protect forests. He also mentioned that efforts to support apple cultivation would begin soon and encouraged those facing difficulties to reach out to him.

hypothesis: 5th STATE LEVEL TASK FORCE MEETING. Today at 11 AM, the State Level Task Force (SLTF) on the National Railway Project members held a meeting in the I&PR Conference Hall under the leadership of Task Force Chairman Mr. Zasanga, IPS (Rtd). In this meeting, Land Acquisition, Forest Clearance, the proposal for Khanrek Railway station, and the construction of a Railway Station at Sihhmui were discussed. Mr. V.P. Srivastava, Chief Engineer, NF Railways, Guwahati, provided a report on the work completed so far, stating that the Final Location Survey (FLS) is progressing smoothly and that the GPS, Traversing, and Topography Surveys between Bairabi and Sairang (51.21 Kms) have been completed. He also mentioned that the Final Stacking Alignment, which began from Bairabi and Hortoki on April 17, 2010, is intended to be completed by May 31, 2010. To oversee the work completed by NF Railways and to ensure that Land Acquisition and Forest Clearance proceed more efficiently, it was decided that three departments—Revenue, Forest, and Railways—will conduct a Joint Survey on April 26, 2010, under the leadership of the Deputy Commissioner of Kolasib.
raw_text: 5th STATE LEVEL TASK FORCE MEETING. Today at 11 AM, the State Level Task Force (SLTF) on the National Railway Project members held a meeting in the I&PR Conference Hall under the leadership of Task Force Chairman Mr. Zasanga, IPS (Rtd). In this meeting, Land Acquisition, Forest Clearance, the proposal for Khanrek Railway station, and the construction of a Railway Station at Sihhmui were discussed. Mr. V.P. Srivastava, Chief Engineer, NF Railways, Guwahati, provided a report on the work completed so far, stating that the Final Location Survey (FLS) is progressing smoothly and that the GPS, Traversing, and Topography Surveys between Bairabi and Sairang (51.21 Kms) have been completed. He also mentioned that the Final Stacking Alignment, which began from Bairabi and Hortoki on April 17, 2010, is intended to be completed by May 31, 2010. To oversee the work completed by NF Railways and to ensure that Land Acquisition and Forest Clearance proceed more efficiently, it was decided that three departments—Revenue, Forest, and Railways—will conduct a Joint Survey on April 26, 2010, under the leadership of the Deputy Commissioner of Kolasib.

reference: PU LAWMAWMA TOCHHAWNG VICE CHAIRMAN HPC INAUGURATES RENOVATED LUNGLEI POLICE STATION BUILDING 151/2023-2024 Lunglei;the 1st August,2023 : Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Vice Chairman, HPC Lunglei inaugurated a newly renovated Lunglei Police Station Building(Ground Floor) here in Lunglei town, today. Lunglei PS building was constructed wayback in 1991 and the building became dilapidated and worn out.Lunglei PS building is a two storey building. Lunglei High Powered Committee Funded this renovation works, at the tune of Rs.15 lakh for each storey. Rs.15 lakh was released for the year 202-2023 which was being used for renovation of Ground Floor, which was inaugurated today. Fund for 1st Floor renovation is also released for the year 2023-2024 and renovation works will be carried out by Police dept, at their earliest. In his augural speech Pu Lawmawma highlighted that Lunglei PS managed to bag the Best Police Station of India Award during 2022-2023.It is quite befitting that the building is also renovated to become the best PS building in Mizoram. He applauded the renovation works executed by PS staff with their all out efforts and with a spirit of love and ownership to get the best result. He exhorted them, since they could manage to bag the Best PS Award too, to try for the Best in traffic management in the whole India. He implored PS staff to be friendly and polite all the time, so that the public will not have any hesitation and fear in approaching the Police station in their time of troubles and distresses. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) and Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC delivered speeches in this function as well. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) informed the gathering public how HPC had helped police dept. time and again since many past years and said that renovation works was just one amongst many. He entreated and reminded the police dept. to pay back many blessings they had received from various quarters by rendering their best services to the society. Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC Lunglei heartily congratulated PS staff for their newly renovated building and applauded them for their dedication and hard work put forth in their renovation works and added that it was worth emulating for other depts. Todayâ€™s brief inaugural function was presided over Pu K.Beihmotaosa MPS,Addl.SP Lunglei and Pu Rahool Alwal IPS, SP Lunglei delivered welcome speech,and technical report was given by Pu L.P Zohmangaiha,OC Lunglei PS. hypothesis: VICE CHAIRMAN OF HPC, PU LAWMAWMA TOCHHAWNG, INAUGURATES RENOVATED LUNGLEI POLICE STATION BUILDING 1328/2023-2025 Lunglei; August 1st, 2023: Today at 11:30 AM, the renovated Lunglei Police Station Building (Ground Floor) was inaugurated by the guest of honor, Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Vice Chairman of the HPC Lunglei. The funds for the renovation were provided by the Lunglei High Powered Committee (HPC) Fund. A total of Rs. 15 lakh each was sanctioned from the HPC Fund for the renovation of the ground floor and the first floor. The ground floor, inaugurated today, was constructed using the 2022-2023 fund. For the renovation of the first floor, Rs. 15 lakh has already been sanctioned for 2023-2024, and the Police Department can begin those renovation works immediately. The Lunglei Police Station building was constructed in 1991 and is located in the heart of Lunglei town; the building had become very old. Speaking at the inauguration of the renovated Police Station Building today, Pu Lawmawma stated that Lunglei Police Station holds the title of being the Best Police Station in India. He noted that after being evaluated on various criteria, it was recognized as the best in the country, and therefore, renovating it to be the best Police Station building in Mizoram is fitting for its status. He added that while he congratulates the police, he also feels it is important for him to be aware of this. Pu Lawmawma further praised the Lunglei Police Station staff for working on the renovation with a sense of ownership, stating that it is a pleasure to work with those who deserve praise. The guest of honor urged the Lunglei Police to strive to maintain their position as the best in India, particularly in traffic management within their jurisdiction. He expressed his wish that, along with the new building, the PS staff would continue to welcome those who visit them with kindness and courtesy, ensuring the police station remains a place where the public feels comfortable approaching to report their difficulties and grievances. The inauguration ceremony was held at the police station premises and was led by Pu K. Beihmotaosa, MPS, Addl. SP Lunglei, with speeches delivered by Pu H. Ram

hypothesis:
SIAHA DC PAYS SURPRISE VISITS TO SEVERAL OFFICES
The Deputy Commissioner of Siaha District, Mr. Bhupesh Chaudhary, IAS, paid surprise visits to several offices this afternoon. Mr. Bhupesh stated that the purpose of these "surprise visits" is not to find faults in the functioning of the offices or to create trouble, but to understand how the various offices are operating and to address any difficulties they may be facing. At the same time, the DC wants it to be known that he will be monitoring the work and conduct of the various offices under his jurisdiction, and he will be very strict with staff who neglect their duties or are reluctant to be present. The offices visited today include the ITI (Industrial Training Institute), Excise & Narcotics Office, Mizofed, Printing & Stationery Depot, and the FCS & Consumer Affairs Godown. These surprise visits are conducted as time permits, with the intention of visiting all offices and educational institutions under the Government of Mizoram (GoM). The DC was accompanied on today's surprise visits by Mr. Amol Srivastava, IAS, Asst. Commissioner; Mr. H. Zonunmawia, Election Officer; and Mr. N. Vabeiratlua, DIPRO. Attachment Loading attachment...

reference: DISTRICT TASK FORCE COMMITTEE HELD EMERGENCY MEETING ON COVID-19 AT SIAHA District Task Force,Siaha mulled over how to take preventive measures against Covid-19 pandemic in the emergency meeting held, here at Siaha. District Magistrate had already issued prohibitory order on last Friday(7/3/2020), the order prohibited Cross- border movement between Myanmar and India through passages/roads that linked Myanmar and 10 villages within Siaha district namely: : Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno,Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki and Khopai village. The Same order highlighted that Check points will be set up at 3 villages namely: Kaochao, Tlapi and Tipi Ferry which located at Inter District Border. In pursuant to the said prohibitory Order, Siaha BDO and Tipa BDO have left for those 10 villages to call for GramSabha meeting and to sensitize about Covid-19 and Prohibitory Order. Today's meeting resolved that villagers of those 10 villages be requested to form a joint committee comprising of Church, NGOs and Village council to vigil over border passage/road that linked their respective village and Myanmar.The meeting also resolved that MADC Forest Guard and India Army stationed at villages located India-Myanmar Border be requested to help proposed village's Joint committee in their vigilant works on Border road/passage. Today's meeting also decided that on the 13th&14th March,2020 a Team comprising Medical officials, Leaders of NGOs, Joint VC members, Police personnel and DC office staff will visited those 13 villages and witness preventive measures taken by each village and carry out sensitization campaign as well. CMO & DMS informed the meeting that there was only one Thermal Infra Red Sensor and 15 Personal Protection Equipments (PPE) presently at Siaha; and 2 TIRS will arrive shortly. TIRS and Self Reporting Format will be placed at check points; and by using TIRS leh Self reporting format; suspected Covid-19 infected travellers will be identified and quarantine for 20 days. hypothesis: DISTRICT TASK FORCE COMMITTEE HELD EMERGENCY MEETING ON COVID-19 IN SIAHA. Today at 2:00 PM, the District Task Force Committee held an emergency meeting in the DC Conference Hall regarding COVID-19; they had a detailed discussion on how to keep Siaha district safe from COVID-19. On March 7, 2020, the District Magistrate closed the routes leading to Myanmar from 10 villages in Siaha district: Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno, Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki, and Khopai. In addition to this, an order has been issued to set up check posts at 3 inter-district border crossing points: Kaochao, Tipi Ferry, and Tlapi. The Siaha BDO and Tipa BDO have also departed today to conduct sensitization campaigns through Gram Sabhas in these 13 villages. During today's meeting, it was decided to request the formation of joint committees consisting of the Church, NGOs, and Village Councils (VC) in these 13 villages, and these joint committees are requested to monitor the routes/paths leading to Myanmar along with their villages. They also decided to involve the MADC Forest Department and the Indian Army stationed in border area villages for assistance. On March 13 and 14, 2020, a joint team comprising medical personnel, NGO leaders, Joint VC leaders, Police, and the DC office will visit these 13 villages to help them monitor the routes to Myanmar for COVID-19 prevention and conduct sensitization campaigns. Currently, the Siaha Medical Office has only one Thermal Infra Red Sensor (TIRS) for detecting fever and 15 sets of Personal Protection Equipment (PPE), with a report that 2 more TIRS are on the way. These TIRS will be placed at the three check posts. In addition to the TIRS, the medical department will place Self Reporting Formats at all 3 check points. Any traveler suspected of having COVID-19 based on the TIRS and Self Reporting Format who enters Siaha district will be quarantined for 20 days. Attachment Loading attachment...

The Champhai District Consultative Committee (DCC)/ District Level Review Committee (DLRC) held a meeting today at the DC Conference Hall, chaired by the Chairman, Pi Maria C.T. Zuali, DC Champhai. Zuali emphasized the need to provide banking facilities to people in remote areas and stated that extensive awareness programs are necessary so that those eligible for benefits through banking can actually receive them. She urged bank officials to translate and publish important documents and application forms in the Mizo language so that the public can better understand how to utilize bank services and be clearly aware of available benefits. She further urged that the poor and marginalized be assisted in accessing benefits and improving their livelihoods. Lawmvela, Lead District Manager (LDM), SBI Lead Bank Office Champhai, delivered the welcome address, followed by a review of the work and progress of various banks in Champhai District up to the end of the September 2020 Quarter and a discussion on future plans. According to the meeting, the average Credit Deposit (CD) Ratio for various banks in Champhai District up to the end of the September 2020 Quarter was 44.71%, an increase of 2.28% from the 42.43% at the end of the June Quarter; however, this still falls short of the 60% CD Ratio target. source: Governor Hari Babu leh ITCA hotupa in Mizorama zirlai thiam zual te tana space technology zir theih dan sawi dun 1070/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Vawiin chawhma khan Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati leh Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA), Bangalore te chu Raj Bhavan-ah an inkawm a. He hunah hian Mizorama zirlai thiam filawr te zinga space technology zir duh thlan chhuah dan tur leh an zir theih dan tur te an sawi dun a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Mizorama zirlaite chu lehkha thiam thei tak leh hmundanga zirlaite el phaka thluak tha an ni tih a sawi a. Space technology pawh a zirna kawng a inhawn phawt chuan hlawhtling takin an zir thei turah angai tih a sawi a ni. Governor chuan Dr SK Prasad leh a thawhna hmuna thuneituten Mizoramah zirlai te tan Space Technology zir theihna hun remchang an rawn zawn sak chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi a. Hemi kawngah hian ITCA hotute chuan Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department leh Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram berawn se. Anni nena indawrna kaltlang hian zirlai thiam thei zual zinga space technology zir duhte thlanchhuah a awlsam a rin thu a sawi a ni. Dr SK Prasad chuan Prime Minister hmathlir angin India thalaite chu space technology lamah thiamna sang zawk nei tur leh India ram chu a hmahruaitu a nih theih nan chher hriam mek an ni a ti a. He hmalakna kal zelah hian zirlai team 75 te chu kumina project 75 thawk zo hman turin Students' Satellites 75 project hnuaiah satellite te chi(mini satellite) siam turin thlan an ni dawn an a ti. He project-ah hian India rama zirlaite zawng zawng an inel dawn a team 75 thlan an ni dawn a ti a. He project-ah hian Mizorama zirlaite tan pawh tel theihna hun a inhawng thei dawn niin a sawi a ni. Dr Prasad chuan a lo kal chhan tak chu Higher Secondary atanga University Degree zirlaite tan Space Technology zirna an kalpui mek chu Mizorama zirlaite rawn hmelhriat tir a ni a ti a. Hemi kawngah hian Governor leh state sawrkar hotute thlawpna a rawn ngen bakah a bikin science lam zirna kaihhnawiha hotute thawhpuiah a rawn sawm tih a sawi bawk a ni. reference: Governor Hari Babu and ITCA member discuss opportunities for students to learn space technology 102/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA) had called on Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati at the Raj Bhavan this forenoon. In this meeting, he and Governor discussed the opportunities for the students of higher secondary school, college and university in Mizoram to learn space technology. As proposed by his eminent guest, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati welcomed the idea of selecting students with a scientific temper to have a preliminary introduction to space science with the option to continue the advanced study depending on their performance in studies. In this regard, he advised Dr SK Prasad and the institutions he represented to have close coordination with the authorities of Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department and Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram. Dr SK Prasad apprised the Governor of their initiatives in teaching the teams of students and assigning them important science projects like making mini satellites and other space technology. He explained the importance given to horning entrepreneurship skills of the students selected in this model of learning. He told Governor that his purpose of visiting is identifying the institutions with whom they will have a series of correspondences to initiate enrollment of the students in the program. hypothesis: Governor Hari Babu and ITCA head discuss space technology opportunities for bright students in Mizoram 1070/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: This afternoon, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati and Dr. SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member of the Indian Technology Congress Association (ITCA), Bangalore, met at Raj Bhavan. During this meeting, they discussed how to select bright students in Mizoram who wish to study space technology and the means by which they can do so. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati stated that students in Mizoram are highly educated and possess intellects equal to students elsewhere. He mentioned that if the path to studying space technology is opened, they are likely to succeed in it. The Governor expressed his gratitude to Dr. SK Prasad and the authorities of his organization for seeking opportunities for students in Mizoram to study Space Technology. In this regard, the ITCA officials suggested collaborating with the Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, the Science & Technology Department, and the Science Teachers Association of Mizoram. He stated that coordinating with them would make it easier to select those among the brightest students who wish to study space technology. Dr. SK Prasad stated that, as envisioned by the Prime Minister, Indian youth are being sharpened to acquire higher expertise in space technology so that India can become a leader in the field. As part of this initiative, 75 student teams will be selected under the "Students' Satellites 75" project to create small satellites (mini satellites) and complete 75 projects per year. He mentioned that students from all over India will compete for this project, and 75 teams will be chosen, noting that opportunities will also open for students in Mizoram to participate. Dr. Prasad explained that the primary purpose of his visit was to introduce the ongoing Space Technology training for students from Higher Secondary to University Degree levels to the students of Mizoram. In this regard, he requested the support of the Governor and state government officials, and specifically invited those involved in science education to collaborate. Attachment Loading attachment...

reference: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK HELD MEETING In pursuance of the decision made by Mizoram State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus, Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus was formed recently and held its first meeting at DC Conference Hall, yesterday. The meeting was presided over by Pu SL Naveen, IAS Deputy Commissioner Champhai. Given its strategic location, Champhai district being located nearby International Border, the meeting mentioned the needs for proper medical screening at Zokhawthar and restriction on movement particularly travellers based on their travelling history. To boost up the preventive measures, the meeting highlighted the importance of fostering better coordination with the neighbouring district administration of Myanmar. The meeting decided to organize awareness campaigns for villages nearby border areas and preparation of isolation ward for quarantine in case any suspect is detected. CMO Office was assigned to prepare budget encompassing all requirements for further submission to the higher authority. At the border Town of Zokhawthar, Government of Mizoram has been monitoring the situation and is conducting Medical Screening since the 4th of February 2020 with proper Self Reporting Form. Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak Contact Number is given as 8588009756/9436376607.

CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK MEETING
To ensure that Champhai District remains safe and protected against the Novel Coronavirus (2019-nCoV) disease, which is currently receiving great attention in China and other countries around the world, the District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak was convened for the first time today at noon in the DC Conference Hall by Deputy Commissioner Pu SL Naveen, IAS. During the meeting, it was noted that since Champhai District is located on the international border, caution is required to prevent the spread of the Novel Coronavirus; the meeting urged frequent travelers and traders crossing the border to be careful regarding the area where the disease is spreading and its symptoms. At this time, the movement of people and livestock is also being monitored. It was also mentioned that it is necessary to maintain communication and coordination with the districts of Myanmar bordering Champhai District. The District Task Force on Coronavirus Outbreak stated that awareness campaigns should be expanded by visiting villages along the border, and those entering through the border should be screened for health and questioned if necessary. In addition to establishing an Isolation Ward at the Champhai District Hospital, it was decided that the necessary budget should be promptly submitted to higher authorities. The District Level Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak was established to take action in each district as desired by the State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus, which was formed during a meeting of the Mizoram State Health Minister and H&FW Department officials on January 30, 2020. Medical screening began at Zokhawthar in Champhai District on February 4, 2020, where visitors are questioned and checked as necessary, and a formal Self Reporting Form has also been implemented. As we have listened, there was a Government of India notification on September 
24, 2020, and based on that, all the states followed. But ‘water’ falls under the state list, 
so the state government has the authority. 16 states and 5 UTs currently have a similar
act regarding this, and 11 states are currently discussing this Act. Four states regarded 
it as unnecessary to have this Act, these are Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Sikkim, and 
Tripura. On the other hand, I believe Mizoram urgently requires this Act, but there must
